cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know this board game. I'm opening with the horse in the lake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A scoring test, exactly. Set it up for me; I'll handle the opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave it fixed, then. Choose my first playing piece. I'll show you why it wins.

reason: Final speech edit replaces testing-every-position explanation with a promise to demonstrate winning play from the piece B chooses.
